quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on his transition to the Clippers' system
quotes.excerpt: the coaching stuff and everybody is just the communication is really good here.
quotes.quote: This is week two or week three. It has been great. I have been on different teams, but here the coaching stuff and everybody is just the communication is really good here. For me, it is really important, especially this group, a lot of new guys. Communication is very important in this stage, and it has been great. I have been having fun, getting some good work in, practice, a couple games, and I feel good about it.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura says the communication within the new Clippers group has been great so far. He feels good about the work they have been putting in during practice and early games.

quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on his defensive versatility and offensive role
quotes.excerpt: I can guard from two to five. So we are trying to figure out the best situation.
quotes.quote: I can guard from two to five. So we are trying to figure out the best situation for my team in a standpoint and my ability. Offense, what are the spots that I can get out of manage those mismatches, get into the spots, using my teammates to kind of create the offense. Those kind of stuff is the most thing that I talk with Ty and it has been great.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura on his role with the Clippers: I can guard from two to five. We are trying to figure out the best situation for my team and my ability.

quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on his familiarity with Tyronn Lue
quotes.excerpt: Me and him had the same trainer in DC and he came to here, Ty.
quotes.quote: Me and him had the same trainer in DC and he came to here, Ty. He is the guy, my guy too. It is good to have somebody like that, adjusting, being around with them, especially Ty. He was literally my vet, first year, so I love just being around with him.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura on his relationship with Tyronn Lue: He was literally my vet my first year so I love just being around him.

quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on the defensive impact of Derrick Jones Jr. and Kris Dunn
quotes.excerpt: They have the quick hands, so they can steal the balls, they can deflect the ball.
quotes.quote: I felt the last game against the Raptors, it just felt different. They have the quick hands, so they can steal the balls, they can deflect the ball. It doesn't show on the stats, but I see a lot of things that they do on the court. Of course, they have the good offense, they can shoot catch and shoot, and they are athletic, very athletic, they can move a lot. I love playing with them.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura is impressed by the defensive impact of Kris Dunn and Derrick Jones Jr. saying they have quick hands and are very athletic.

quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on the difficulty of playing against a defensive tandem
quotes.excerpt: It is annoying. They are trying to disrupt the offense. You don't know what they are going to do.
quotes.quote: It is annoying. They are trying to disrupt the offense. You don't know what they are going to do. Sometimes they are trying to steal the ball, they are trying to deflect the ball. Those little stuff is for the team, you are in. As a coaching staff too, I think that is what they want from players.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura on facing the defensive pressure of his own teammates: It is annoying. They are trying to disrupt the offense. You do not know what they are going to do.

quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on the leadership of Darius Garland
quotes.excerpt: He is a great offense player, but also he is a leader. He talks a lot.
quotes.quote: He is a great offense player, but also he is a leader. He talks a lot. I didn't really know him before, but he talks for the team. A lot of things that I can see he teaching and those rookie guys, talking to them on the side. I like him and of course everybody likes him.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura praises Darius Garland for his leadership: He is a great offensive player but also he is a leader. He talks a lot for the team.

quotes.speaker: Chris Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Dunn on his role and approach with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: Just coming in, guard, do what I do, bring energy, get guys involved, knock down shots.
quotes.quote: Just coming in, guard, do what I do, bring energy, get guys involved, knock down shots, bring a type of intensity to the game.
quotes.social_post: Kris Dunn on his approach with the Clippers: Just coming in, guard, do what I do, bring energy, get guys involved, knock down shots, bring a type of intensity to the game.

quotes.speaker: Chris Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Dunn on the development of his younger teammates
quotes.excerpt: He is a fast learner, confident kid, can really score the ball once he gets going.
quotes.quote: He is a fast learner, confident kid, can really score the ball once he gets going. We know he is going to have ups and downs. He is young, the league is not easy as we know. It is a different transition. He doesn't shy away from coming in and putting the work in each and every day. He really cares about the game.
quotes.social_post: Kris Dunn on the young players: He is a fast learner, confident kid, can really score the ball once he gets going. He does not shy away from coming in and putting the work in.

quotes.speaker: Chris Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Dunn on mentoring young players through high-draft-pick pressure
quotes.excerpt: There shouldn't be no pressure. I tell them you are going to have a great game.
quotes.quote: There shouldn't be no pressure. I understand, trust me, I have been in those shoes. I tell them you are going to have a great game, you are going to have bad games. The main thing is just making sure that you bring the same mentality each and every time and be even-kill. Come in, have a routine, be prepared, put the work in, and everything is going to fall into place for you.
quotes.social_post: Kris Dunn on mentoring young players: There should not be no pressure. I tell them you are going to have a great game, you are going to have bad games. The main thing is just making sure that you bring the same mentality.

quotes.speaker: Chris Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Dunn on the team's chemistry and collective buy-in
quotes.excerpt: We understand we don't have superstars all around, maybe some other teams, so we have to come in.
quotes.quote: We understand we don't have superstars all around, maybe some other teams, so we have to come in and be bought into the system, play together, have the chemistry right, and go out there and have the right intensity.
quotes.social_post: Kris Dunn on the Clippers identity: We understand we do not have superstars all around like some other teams, so we have to come in and be bought into the system, play together, and have the chemistry right.

quotes.speaker: Chris Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Dunn on his personal approach to leadership
quotes.excerpt: I just try to be myself. I don't try to look at it like taking the bigger role.
quotes.quote: I just try to be myself. I don't try to look at it like taking the bigger role or anything. I tell people this all the time, that is just who I am. I am going to come in and be happy. I love the game of basketball. I like to see others do well. And then I am also a learner. Like Ketan, he is young, he told me things, I take in what he tells me. I am not one of those guys that because I have been in the league for a little bit that I can't always learn. I am always trying to learn.
quotes.social_post: Kris Dunn on his leadership style: I just try to be myself. I am not one of those guys that because I have been in the league for a little bit that I cannot always learn.

quotes.speaker: Chris Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Dunn on the team's preparation and excitement for the season
quotes.excerpt: If anything, we should be excited. Other guys get to step up, this opportunity is out there.
quotes.quote: If anything, we should be excited. Other guys get to step up, this opportunity is out there. We all just have to buy in to what Ty and Jalen Brunson are saying on both sides of the ball, have the chemistry, play hard, and then see if we can go out there and get wins.
quotes.social_post: Kris Dunn on the upcoming season: We should be excited. Other guys get to step up, this opportunity is out there. We all just have to buy in to what Ty is saying.

quotes.speaker: Chris Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Dunn on the impact of playing with a high-pace point guard
quotes.excerpt: He is going to push the pace, he is going to get guys involved, he is going to give.
quotes.quote: He is going to push the pace, he is going to get guys involved, he is going to give guys easy looks honestly. And what he brings to the table, you don't get that a lot in the league. Just how fast he is, the way he is able to make plays, make reads, he is just special player.
quotes.social_post: Kris Dunn on playing with a high-pace point guard: He is going to push the pace, he is going to get guys involved, he is going to give guys easy looks. He is just a special player.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the challenge of a long preseason schedule
quotes.excerpt: We got to use it smart. We got to be smart about it, but we got to get.
quotes.quote: We got to use it smart. We got to be smart about it, but we got to get up and down because seven days in between games is a long time. So we got to try to stay sharp as best we can, play some half-court scrimmages and play a lot, but we will see how it goes, but that is a long time to be off.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on the long preseason schedule: Seven days in between games is a long time. So we have to try to stay sharp as best we can, play some half-court scrimmages.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on his expectations for Kris Dunn's offensive role
quotes.excerpt: Just running the team, I think, being able to get in the paint, make plays for guys.
quotes.quote: Just running the team, I think, being able to get in the paint, make plays for guys and taking his open shots. He is really improved his three-point shooting, so taking and making open shots, but also running the offense and getting our guys in the right spot.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Kris Dunn: He has really improved his three-point shooting, so taking and making open shots, but also running the offense and getting our guys in the right spot.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the progress of Brandon Boston Jr.
quotes.excerpt: He is been increasing, he is been ramped up and he is doing a lot more.
quotes.quote: He is been increasing, he is been ramped up and he is doing a lot more. So just seeing him on the floor, that is a good sign. This is going to still take some time, it is going to be a while, but just seeing him on the floor, being able to do certain things, it has been good to see.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Brandon Boston Jr.: He has been ramping up and doing a lot more. It is going to take some time, it is going to be a while, but just seeing him on the floor is a good sign.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland's leadership and offensive growth
quotes.excerpt: Just pushing pace, I think making plays for his teammates. We have done a lot of talking about.
quotes.quote: Just pushing pace, I think making plays for his teammates. We have done a lot of talking about what he feels comfortable at doing, what he likes, and he has been really good. So we changed a couple things up and we will see how it looks tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland: Just pushing pace, making plays for his teammates. We have done a lot of talking about what he feels comfortable doing and he has been really good.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on managing the rotation by committee
quotes.excerpt: Just doing it by committee, you know, whatever makes sense, whatever is the best fit.
quotes.quote: Just doing it by committee, you know, whatever makes sense, whatever is the best fit. Not just one person is going to be able to slide in and, you know, he is a 40% three-point shooter that can move, catch and shoot. His movement causes confusion, so we are really going to miss that.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on rotation strategy: Just doing it by committee, whatever makes sense, whatever is the best fit.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on congratulating Natalie Nakase on her WNBA success
quotes.excerpt: Just congratulating her, beating a very good team and the Aces, best coach in the WNBA.
quotes.quote: Just congratulating her, beating a very good team and the Aces, best coach in the WNBA. They won the last two championships, right? Yeah, back-to-back championships and going in to beat a team like that just shows you what kind of coach Natalie is and I am happy for her.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue congratulates Natalie Nakase on her WNBA success: Beating a team like that just shows you what kind of coach Natalie is and I am happy for her.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the development of Spencer Rattler
quotes.excerpt: It has been great, just seeing Spencer since he was a little, little, little kid.
quotes.quote: It has been great, just seeing Spencer since he was a little, little, little kid and to where he is now, very good. He can do a lot of different things, helps Jalen with the defense, player development. Haven't really had him incorporating the offensive stuff yet, but I know he knows that, so just happy to have him here, he has been great.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Spencer Rattler: He helps Jalen with the defense and player development. Happy to have him here, he has been great.
